newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: M&R sells shares in Zimbabwe's IHL.
newsitem.headline: M&R sells shares in Zimbabwe's IHL.

text.p: South African holding group Murray & Roberts Holdings Ltd said on Monday that it had sold part of its stake in Harare-based International Holdings Ltd to a consortium of Zimbabwean businessman.
The deal will see M&R reduce its stake from 64.7 percent to 43.7 percent.

"As a result control of IHL will be localised and the M&R group will have made important progress in its strategy of developing partnerships in the markets in which it operates," M&R said in a statement.
The firm gave no details of the price-tag for the stake and a M&R spokeswoman said the sum involved was not yet being disclosed.
IHL is a holding firm with interests in a variety of Zimbabwean firms ranging from International Construction Zimbabwe Ltd to Air Technicians.
M&R said it was still committed to links with IHL and would continue having representation on its board.
